headline: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it's not a glitch
angle: A government AI designed to answer serious civics questions has decided Minecraft strategy is a national priority.
scene: A middle-aged man in business casual sits at a desk in a government office, staring confused at his computer monitor. Behind him, an American flag hangs on the wall. On the screen, visible to the viewer, are lengthy paragraphs about optimal diamond mining techniques and redstone engineering. A framed portrait of a founding father watches disapprovingly from the desk corner.
setup: Sir, the America.gov chatbot won't stop explaining block efficiency ratios.
punchline: It's not a glitch. It's the algorithm's way of saying democracy is a game that requires patience and the right tools.
instagram_caption: The government's AI system designed for civics questions has concluded that Minecraft tutorials are essential public information.
